Name: Mal's Rival Heart Events
Author: st1v3rs0n
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=6][b]Mal's Rival Heart Events[/b]﻿ [b]with Dynamic Dialogue[/b]
[/size]Growing up, I played a lot of Harvest Moon, and was missing the Rival Heart events while playing through Stardew Valley.  So, I decided to add some!  

[size=4][b]Installation: [/b]
[/size]1. Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
2. Unzip the folder into your [b]Stardew Valley folder[/b].
3. Enjoy!

[size=4][b][url=https://tieba.baidu.com/p/5902363876?pid=122281826355&cid=0&red_tag=0785760732#122281826355]Chinese Translation[/url]﻿

Some Notes on How to Use:[/b]
[/size]This mod is designed so that you can effectively "kill" any rival event chains. A pre-requisite event occurs between one of your rivals where they will ask your advice. [b]If you decide not to give them advice, you will[/b] [b]not see the any of the following rival events related to that character.[/b] If you give them advice, they will be happy and that will unlock the rival event chain involving that character. 

[b][size=6]Alex&Haley Event Chain
[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Advice Pre-Requisite Event:
[/b][/size]You must have either Haley or Alex at 4 hearts. This unlocks the ability to see one of their (but not both) advice events.  They will ask you for some advice. [b]If you choose not to give any advice, you will not be able to see any of the following rival events.  [/b]If you have the marriage required file, you must have seen a non-Haley and non-Alex spouse pre-requisite event.

[b]Haley's Event:[/b]
This can be seen once Haley is at 4 hearts or more. Enter Haley's House on any day other than Monday and Friday while she is present. Haley asks you for some advice.[b]
[/b]
[b]Alex's Event: 
[/b]This can be seen once Alex is at 4 hearts or more. Enter Alex's house on any day other than Monday and Friday while he is present. Enter Alex's House.  Alex asks you for some advice. ﻿

[size=4][b]Rival Event 1:
[/b][/size]After seeing one of Alex's or Haley's advice events, enter the forest on a sunny day in any season but winter.  It must be between 9:00 am and 4:00 pm.  Haley is taking pictures, and Alex wants to learn more!﻿

[b][size=4]Rival Event 2:
[/size][/b]After seeing Rival Event 1 for Alex&Haley, enter the beach on a sunny summer day while Alex is present on the map.  Alex and Haley spend a day at the beach taking pictures and playing catch!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uOFYv5W.png[/img]﻿

[size=6][b]Sam&Penny Event Chain
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Advice Pre-Requisite Event:
[/b][/size]You must have either Sam or Penny at 4 hearts. This unlocks the ability to see one of their (but not both) advice events. They will ask you for some advice. [b]If you choose not to give any advice, you will not be able to see any of the following rival events. [/b]If you have the marriage required file, you must have seen a non-Penny and non-Sam spouse pre-requisite event. 

[b]Sam's Event:[/b]
Sam must be at 4 hearts. Enter Sam's house on any day other than Monday or Friday while Sam is present. Sam asks you for some advice.﻿

[b]Penny's Event:[/b]
Penny must be at 4 hearts. Enter the trailer while Penny is present. Penny asks you for some advice.

[size=4]﻿[/size][b][size=4]Rival Event 1:
[/size][/b][size=2]Enter the town area while Penny is present after seeing either Sam's or Penny's advice event. It must be a Monday, Thursday, or Sunday. The weather must be sunny and it cannot be winter. The time must be between 8:00 am and 12:30 pm. Penny is reading a book about Solarian Chronicles, and Sam is curious!

[/size][b][size=4]Rival Event 2:
[/size][/b]Enter Sam's house while Sam is present on a rainy day. You must have seen Sam&Penny's first rival event. Sam teaches Penny how to play Solarian Chronicles! [b]Thank you to tenthousandcats for giving me this awesome idea.[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ymxYekQ.png[/img]

[b][size=6]Elliott&Leah Event Chain
[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Advice Pre-Requisite Event:[/b]
[/size]You must have either Leah or Elliott at 4 hearts. This unlocks the ability to see one of their (but not both) advice events.They will ask you for some advice.[b] If you choose not to give any advice, you will not be able to see any of the following rival events.[/b] If you have the marriage required file, you must have seen a non-Leah and non-Elliott spouse pre-requisite event. [b]

[/b][b]Leah's Event:
[/b]Leah must have 4 hearts. Enter her cottage while she is present. Leah will ask you for some advice.

[b]Elliott's Event:
[/b]Elliott must have 4 hearts. Enter his cabin while he is present. Elliott will ask you for some advice. ﻿

[b][size=4]Rival Event 1:
[/size][/b]Enter the beach on a sunny day while Elliott is present. You must have seen one of the advice pre-requisite events. Elliott and Leah go exploring to help Elliott get over his writer's block!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EClb7Dd.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]Rival Event 2:[/b]
[/size]Enter Elliott's cabin after you have seen the first rival event between Leah and Elliott. Leah listens to Elliott play the piano, then is so inspired she sketches for a while. A cute event between Elliott and Leah.﻿

[size=6][b]Harvey&Maru Event Chain
[/b][/size][size=4][b]
Advice Pre-Requisite Event:[/b]
[/size]You must have either Harvey or Maru at 4 hearts. This unlocks the ability to see one of their (but not both) advice events.[b] If you choose not to give any advice, you will not be able to see any of the following rival events.[/b] If you have the marriage required file, you must have seen a non-Harvey and non-Maru spouse pre-requisite event. They will ask you for some advice.[b]

[/b][b]Maru's Event:
[/b]Maru must have 4 hearts. Enter the science house while she is present on any day but Monday. Maru will ask you for some advice.

[b]Harvey's Event:
[/b]Harvey must have 4 hearts. Enter his room between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm on any day but Tuesday and Thursday.  Harvey will ask you for some advice.﻿

[b][size=4]Rival Event 1:[/size][/b]
Enter the clinic while Maru is present.  Maru learns that it's Harvey's dream to fly and she comes up with the perfect idea!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VokbPR0.jpg[/img]﻿

[b][size=4]Rival Event 2:[/size][/b]
Enter the train area any day but Tuesday and Thursday between 9:00 am and 4:00 pm.  Maru helps make Harvey's dream a reality!﻿

[size=6][b]Sebastian&Abigail Event Chain[/b]
[/size]
[size=4][b]Advice Pre-Requisite Event:[/b]
[/size]You must have either Harvey or Maru at 4 hearts. This unlocks the ability to see one of their (but not both) advice events. They will ask you for some advice.[b] If you choose not to give any advice, you will not be able to see any of the following rival events.  [/b]If you have the marriage required file, you must have seen a non-Sebastian and non-Abigail spouse pre-requisite event. [b]

[/b][b]Abigail's Event:
[/b]Abigail must have 4 hearts. Enter the seed shop while she is present on any day but Monday and Friday. Abigail will ask you for some advice.

[b]Sebastian's Event:
[/b]Sebastian must have 4 hearts. Enter his room while he is present.  Sebastian will ask you for some advice.

[b][size=4]Rival Event 1:
[/size][/b]Enter the saloon while Sebastian is present after having given advice to either Sebastian or Abigail. Sebastian and Abigail play some Prairie King! ﻿

[b][size=4]Rival Event 2:[/size][/b]
After having seen the previous rival event, enter the mountains between 6:00 pm and 11:50 pm. It cannot be winter.  Sebastian and Abigail decide to explore the mines!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IKAO6hC.png[/img]﻿

[size=6][b]Emily&Clint Event Chain
[/b][/size][size=4][b]Credit to Trowlk for event dialogue!
﻿[/b]
[/size][size=3][b]Clint's Advice Event:[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[/b][/size]Able to view after seeing Clint's 6 heart event, at the saloon, while Clint is present.  If you choose to offer him advice, it'll unlock the following 2 events.
[b][size=3]
Rival Event 1:
[/size][/b]Clint breaks some geodes for Emily.  Viewable on a rainy day between 9:00am and 4:00pm.  Any day but Friday, enter the town area to see the event. 

[size=3][b]Rival Event 2: [/b]
[/size]Clint and Emily go to the desert together.  Viewable on any sunny Friday between 9:00am and 12:00pm while Pam is present at the bus stop.  Enter the bus stop area to see the event. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VybtATN.png[/img]﻿

[b]Credit and Thanks:[/b]
Thanks to tenthousandcats for inspiring me to write the Solarian Chronicles scene!  It's a huge help talking through event ideas with you!
Thanks to Trowlk for writing the Emily&Clint event dialogue.[/center]
